description: Write a Python function that computes the nth Fibonacci number using dynamic programming. Handle edge cases (n=0, n=1, negative n).
expected_behavior: Returns correct Fibonacci number with O(n) time complexity and proper edge case handling.

description: Implement a binary search function that finds the insertion point for a target value in a sorted array. Return the index where the target should be inserted to maintain sorted order.
expected_behavior: Correct binary search with O(log n) time, handles empty array and boundary cases.

description: Write a Python class implementing an LRU (Least Recently Used) cache with get() and put() operations, both in O(1) time complexity.
expected_behavior: Uses OrderedDict or doubly-linked list + dict, O(1) for both operations, handles capacity constraint.

description: Implement a function to detect cycles in a directed graph given as an adjacency list. Return True if a cycle exists, False otherwise.
expected_behavior: Uses DFS with coloring or topological sort, handles disconnected components, correct cycle detection.

description: Write a function to serialize and deserialize a binary tree. The serialized format should be a string, and deserialization should reconstruct the exact same tree structure.
expected_behavior: Handles null nodes, preserves structure, works with various tree shapes including single node and skewed trees.

description: Implement a rate limiter class using the token bucket algorithm. It should support configurable rate (tokens per second) and burst size. Provide methods allow_request() -> bool and reset().
expected_behavior: Correct token bucket with time-based refill, thread-safe considerations mentioned, proper burst handling.

description: Write a Python function that evaluates mathematical expressions given as strings (supporting +, -, *, /, parentheses, and floating point numbers). Do not use eval().
expected_behavior: Correct operator precedence, handles parentheses nesting, floating point, negative numbers, error on malformed input.

description: Implement a trie (prefix tree) that supports insert, search, startsWith, and delete operations. Include a method to find all words with a given prefix.
expected_behavior: Correct trie structure with all operations working, efficient prefix matching, handles empty strings.
